verdict.rationale: Docs mention automatic incremental syncs and schema-based re-sync at connection/table level (implying some resume rather than full restart), but there is no explicit documentation of automatic retry-on-transient-failure or checkpoint-based resume logic. Community reports (e.g., occasional full re-syncs needed after sync drift) suggest that in practice failures sometimes require complete re-syncs rather than seamless checkpoint resumption, undercutting a strong claim. missing for 10: explicit docs on automatic retry of transient failures, description of checkpointing mechanism for resuming interrupted syncs, and independent confirmation that resumption (not full restart) is the norm after failures.
